card.title: Authority by Bluff
card.instruction: Project control through confident half-answers while guarding the possibility that one direct question could expose how little you actually know.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've got tomorrow's inspection covered. Leave the folder with me.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Does page four say we need two sinks?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: It requires an appropriate number for the operation.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The plumber's here. Shall I ask him to read it?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Have him quote for one and two. I'll confirm which interpretation we're implementing.
